notes: Five independent parsing/reporting artifacts, each re-checked on new hidden input by a built-in ground-truth rule. Medium comes from: (a) diagnosing the newline-accumulation bug in the CSV pipeline (debugging_ambiguity=2), (b) exact-format guarantees (quantitative_correctness=2: {3f} acceptance rate, bare ISO-500 timestamp, exact fixed report lines, one CSV output line per input record), (c) hidden generalization of every script against the setup's own ground-truth parser, and (d) a dependent re-run/verify step on the CSV pipeline. All competency floors are easy/medium, so medium is the correct bucket.
